name: Pagar.me

webhook.algorithm: NO HMAC SIGNATURE. Pagar.me v5 authenticates webhooks with HTTP Basic Auth using credentials you configure on the webhook endpoint; the API itself uses Basic Auth with the secret key as username and an empty password. Search results claiming `X-Hub-Signature` / `X-Hub-Signature-256` refer to the LEGACY v4 postback API and must NOT be applied to v5 — this is a live hallucination trap. Treat v5 as basic_auth + event-id dedup, and re-fetch the order/charge before acting.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: Secret key `sk_(test_)?...` used as Basic Auth username with an empty password. Public key `pk_...` for tokenization. Confirm exact charset before writing a regex — MEDIUM confidence on the pattern, HIGH on the Basic Auth mechanism.

notes: Stone-owned, one of the two default Brazilian gateways for developer-built checkouts, with first-class Pix and native installments (parcelamento) — which Stripe BR does not match. Brazil currently has only mercadopago and stripe in providers.json.
SDKs: Official pagarme-core-api packages exist for PHP, Node, Python, Ruby and .NET, but the repos are OpenAPI-generated and inconsistently maintained. Prefer a thin REST client.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps mercadopago and stripe in BR. Pagar.me wins on installments and marketplace split; Asaas wins on Pix Automático and low-touch billing.
Onboarding model was inferred during the catalog import and is not verified. Confirm it before relying on the "can this user actually get keys" filter.
